messages.subject: [R-sig-eco] Online course: Lidar Data Analysis in R - 19–21 October
messages.subject_clean: Online course: Lidar Data Analysis in R - 19–21 October
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
Only a few places remain! Join our online course ?Lidar Data Analysis in R?, taking place 19?21 October (Online | 1?5 PM Berlin time)
 
This 3-day, hands-on course is designed for researchers and practitioners working in ecology, forestry, biodiversity, and environmental monitoring. You will learn how to work with LiDAR data in R using the lidR package, from point-cloud processing and classification to generating DTM, DSM and CHM products, extracting ecological and forest metrics, and analysing vegetation structure.
 
The course also includes a practical session on spaceborne LiDAR (GEDI) using QGIS.
 
 
Course website:[ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/lidar-r/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/lidar-r/ ) 
 
 
By the end of the course, you will be able to design and execute a complete LiDAR analysis workflow in R.
 
Best regards,
 
Carlo
 
 

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D
